title: ActionProposal
description: A proposed action that the agent wishes to execute, recorded before any tool is called.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this action proposal.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this proposal belongs to.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool the agent wants to call.

action_type.description: Semantic type of the action, e.g. 'read', 'write', 'external_send'.

target.description: Target resource or endpoint the action operates on.

payload.description: Arguments or payload the agent wants to pass to the tool.

proposed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this proposal was created.

reason.description: Optional explanation from the agent for why this action is needed.
